Shell(cd /Users/apple/coding/8x && git commit -F - <<'EOF' Add automatic prompt/response capture for agent sessions Command Code exposes no "prompt submitted" hook event, so turns are extracted at Stop from the session transcript referenced by transcript_path and appended per session to .agent-logs/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS_<session-id>.md. Each entry records the prompt verbatim, the final response, a UTC timestamp and the model; thinking, tool calls and intermediate steps are deliberately excluded. .commandcode/settings.json wires Stop and SessionStart to .commandcode/hooks/capture-turn.mjs with no matcher (a matcher on those events silently prevents the hook from firing). The hook always exits 0 and prints nothing, so a capture failure can never affect the turn it is recording. Turn counting is kept in a sidecar rather than recounted from the log body: a response that quotes a log entry inflates a marker count and then silently drops every later turn. The fresh-checkout fallback counts only a contiguous, session-matched run of headers. .agent-logs/*.md ship with the repo; only the sidecar counter and the error log are ignored. Verified with canaries in three independent sessions plus a non-canary session - see CAPTURE-TEST.md. EOF echo "=== commit created ===" && git log -1 --stat --format='%H%n%an <%ae>%n%n%s')
